transition.confirmCancel: Cancel this permit? This cannot be undone.

gate.noIsolation: This permit type requires at least one energy isolation before activation.
gate.unverified: Every isolation must be applied and verified by a second person before activation.
gate.removed: A lock has already been removed; this permit can no longer protect work.
gate.pendingRemoval: Every lock removal must be verified before the permit can be closed.
gate.handoverRequired: Record a handover before handing back.
gate.isolationsUnavailable: The isolations of this permit could not be read: no lifecycle step until they are.

isolation.title: LOTO isolation points
isolation.twoPersonHint: Two-person rule: the person who applied an isolation cannot verify it or its removal.
isolation.selfBlocked: You applied this isolation — another person must verify.
isolation.editLocked: Isolations can only be added while the permit is not active.
isolation.loadError: The isolations of this permit could not be loaded
isolation.toReviewHint: The text typed before the lists existed could not be matched: choose the energy type and the method.
isolation.optionsError: The energy and method lists could not be loaded.
isolation.listsHint: Energy types follow ISO 14118 / OSHA 1910.147; isolation methods are your site’s list (Reference data).
isolation.threePersonNotice: Three-person rule: {{name}} verified this isolation and may not confirm its removal.
isolation.threePersonNoticeUnknown: Three-person rule: the person who verified this isolation may not confirm its removal.
isolation.threePersonSelf: You verified this isolation — a third person must confirm its removal.
isolation.cancelConfirm: The line “{{point}}” ({{energy}} · {{method}}) was never applied. It will be marked “Cancelled” and kept in the permit's history: it can no longer be applied, verified or edited.
isolation.cancelResetNotice: This permit is waiting for review: it will go back to draft and must be submitted again.
isolation.cancelHint: A line never applied can be cancelled while the permit is a draft or waiting for review; a fitted lock is removed with a verified removal.
isolation.removalConfirmDescription: You confirm that the isolation "{{point}}" has been removed. Applied by {{applier}}, verified by {{verifier}}. Your name will be recorded as the person who verified the removal.
isolation.removerBlocked: You took this lock off — another person must verify its removal.
isolation.awaitingTakeOff: Waiting for {{name}} to record “I removed my lock” (or a forced removal if they are absent).
isolation.takeOffConfirmTitle: Confirm you took your lock off
isolation.takeOffConfirmDescription: You confirm that you have taken your lock off the isolation “{{point}}”. From now on this isolation no longer protects the work: nobody may work under it, and another person must verify the removal before the permit can be closed.

card.title: LOTO card
card.doNotOperate: DANGER — DO NOT OPERATE. Equipment locked out.

handover.rolesHint: Pick the role of the person handing over and of the one receiving, from the plant's hand-over roles.
handover.onlyWhenClosed: The hand-over is recorded once the permit is closed.
handover.title: Handovers
handover.noRoles: No hand-over role yet: an administrator must fill the list “Rôles de passation de permis” (permit hand-over roles) in Reference data.
handover.receiverHint: You sign the hand-over yourself; the receiving person cannot be you.
handover.receiversPartial: {{shown}} of {{total}} people shown: type a name to narrow the list.
handover.signerNotRecorded: Signer not recorded (hand-over recorded before signers were kept)

create.title: New work permit
create.expiresHint: Defaults to the permit type's maximum duration.

types.noViewRight: Viewing permit types needs the work-permit view right.
types.readOnly: Changing permit types needs the permit issuer right.
types.title: Permit types
types.name: Name
types.codeLocked: The code of an existing type cannot be changed: permits and rules refer to it. Create a new type if needed.
types.energyIsolationHint: A permit of this type cannot start without at least one isolation applied and verified by a second person.
types.energyIsolationLocked: The LOTO type always requires an energy isolation.
types.energyIsolationAdminOnly: Only an administrator (settings right) can stop requiring it.
types.disableReason: Why no longer require an isolation?
types.disableReasonHint: At least {{min}} characters. Only an administrator can do this; the password is asked again and the change is recorded in the audit log.
types.threePerson: Three-person rule: a third person confirms lock removal
types.threePersonHint: When on, the person who verified an isolation may not confirm its removal either: a third person must.
types.threePersonAdminOnly: Only an administrator (settings right) can change this setting.
types.threePersonReasonHint: At least {{min}} characters. Your password is asked again and the change is recorded in the audit log.

woGate.required: This work order requires an active work permit before it can start.
woGate.ready: Permit is active: work can start.

forced.title: Forced lock removal — worker absent
forced.description: The lock “{{point}}” was fitted by {{worker}}, who is absent. As a holder of the permit close right at this site, you authorise another person to take it off. Your password will be asked again.
forced.remover: Person who takes the lock off
forced.removersPartial: {{shown}} of {{total}} people shown: refine the search.
forced.reasonMin: Give the reason in {{min}} characters at least.
forced.attemptsHint: At least one: when, how (your site's contact methods, Reference data) and what came of it.
forced.noMethods: No contact method is active in Reference data (PERMIT.CONTACT_METHODS): ask an administrator to add one.
forced.attemptsIncomplete: Give the time, the method and the result of each attempt.
forced.attest: I attest that the worker is not on the site.
forced.attestHint: Required by OSHA 1910.147(e)(3)(ii): the employer verifies that the authorised employee is not at the facility.
forced.stepUpHint: Recording a forced removal asks for your password again; it is audited and announced to the permit close-right holders of the site.

informed.title: The worker was told of the forced removal
informed.description: Record that {{worker}} was told that their lock “{{point}}” was taken off (worker without an account in Maintafox, or told in person). You are recorded as the person who told them.
informed.hint: A worker with an account is also asked to acknowledge it at their next sign-in.
informed.pending: Worker not told yet: they fit no new lock until they are.
informed.doneInApp: Worker told: acknowledged in the app on {{date}}

gateAck.title: One of your locks was taken off while you were absent
gateAck.intro: A forced removal was recorded for a lock you fitted. Read it and acknowledge it before continuing: you cannot fit a new lock until you do.
gateAck.loadError: Your forced lock removals could not be read. Try again: the app stays blocked until they can be checked.

review.title: Forced removals to follow up ({{count}})
review.hint: Locks taken off while their worker was absent: the worker must be told (at their next sign-in, or record it here).
review.loadError: The forced removals to follow up could not be loaded
